map.collector: the platforms (pump.fun, trading bots, Polymarket, Kalshi)
map.contestability: not contestable by capital (owned); edges inside it are speed games
map.method: DefiLlama fees of the categories, 30d x 365/30
map.name: Entertainment platforms: launchpads, trading apps, prediction markets
map.payer: memecoin launch and trading-app users, prediction-market bettors, gamers
map.repo: polymarket_history, pm_crossvenue: no-go (favourites, neg-risk, lags automated)

map.collector: LPs; on memecoin pools much of the liquidity is protocol-seeded and locked
map.contestability: high and racing at launch (JIT, sniping); on majors fees are below LVR for concentrated positions
map.method: DefiLlama supply-side revenue of Dexs, 30d x 365/30 (band low end: the trailing 365 days at the same supply share); above fair is not defined: memecoin LPs hold decaying inventory and major-pair LPs pay LVR (31% to 101% of fees on the main pairs)
map.motive: entertainment and speed of access to new tokens; on majors the flow is mostly arbitrage, which takes LVR from LPs
map.name: DEX LP fees (supply side)
map.payer: memecoin and retail swappers (PumpSwap, Meteora, Raydium, Uniswap v4 on Base) and, on major pairs, informed flow
map.repo: jit-liquidity-mainnet retired; usdg-captive-flow-lp fork-proven (captive subsidized flow is the exception); listing_lifecycle: new tokens decay -25%/-33% at 30/60 days
map.scarce: inventory in a decaying token (memecoins), or the ability to beat LVR (on majors: none without speed)

map.collector: basis desks and Ethena's ~delta-neutral book (Ethena's fees ~$276M/yr include its funding), market makers
map.contestability: high: billions of basis capital arrive within days; altcoin excess lives in thin and new books
map.method: Binance: daily OI history x every settlement of the last 30 days (realised); Bybit/OKX: OI now x last 30 days of settlements, tail extrapolated at the covered rate (high end)
map.motive: leverage demand; funding sits near the 0.01%/8h formula rate
map.name: Binance (top 100 by OI), Bybit and OKX (top 30 each) crypto perps
map.payer: leveraged longs on Binance, Bybit and OKX
map.repo: term_carry: DIY Ethena on Binance no-go; funding_arb: altcoin spreads in sub-$5k books; listing_lifecycle: delisting spread earned weeks before notices
map.scarce: none beyond capital: BTC/ETH funding (4.1-5.0%) is within ~1pp of the savings rate

map.collector: venue token holders (HYPE buybacks take 99% of HL fees), front-ends, and LP vaults (supply side)
map.contestability: LP vaults are open to any depositor (pro-rata), venue fees are not
map.method: DefiLlama 30d fees x 365/30 (band: trailing 365 days); "above fair" = LP-vault fee income above SSR on vault TVL (named vaults only)
map.motive: leverage and venue convenience; front-ends charge for distribution (wallet perps: MetaMask, Phantom, Trust)
map.name: Perp venue fees (DefiLlama Derivatives + perp front-ends)
map.payer: perp traders: taker and maker fees, HIP-3 deployer fees, front-end builder codes
map.repo: none on LP vaults (house_vaults, a sibling study, sizes trader-PnL transfers); usdg-captive-flow-lp is the DEX analogue
map.scarce: a venue or a distribution channel; for LP vaults: tolerance for trader PnL and directional exposure

map.collector: suppliers (after the reserve factor) and protocols
map.contestability: high: dollars arrive within hours; above-fair rents are the price of credit risk
map.method: DefiLlama Lending+CDP fees, 30d x 365/30; above fair = share of interest above each class's fair rate (SSR for dollars, staking for ETH), measured on Aave's and Morpho's own APIs (band: Aave-only to Morpho-only share)
map.motive: leverage on a carry; borrowing dollars against crypto without selling
map.name: Lending and CDP interest paid by borrowers
map.payer: borrowers: dollar loopers (sUSDe, PT and LST carry), market makers (Maple), CDP vaults (Sky)
map.repo: multichain/strategy book: only 2 of 27 dollar reserves beat SSR (~$1M wide); cross-chain book $109k/yr; dollar PTs vs SSR died on defaults
map.scarce: none beyond dollars: supply rates sit at or near the savings rate

map.collector: HL shorts: market makers and basis desks hedging on CEX (two-venue capital), HYPE spot holders, HLP
map.contestability: medium: the HL-Binance spread has persisted for years because two-venue capital costs about as much (funding_arb)
map.method: venue OI now x trailing 30d (and 90d) hourly funding from the repo's store; low end x0.90, the realised/current-OI ratio of path B
map.motive: leverage on a self-custodial venue; they pay ~9-10%/yr for BTC/ETH that cost ~4.4% on Binance
map.name: Hyperliquid main-dex crypto perps
map.payer: leveraged longs on Hyperliquid (retail and on-chain natives; no KYC, high leverage, one wallet)
map.repo: term_carry: HYPE spot-perp carry go (+4.30%/yr, $5M); BTC/ETH watch (t < 1 since 2025-11); funding_arb: HL vs Binance no-go at size
map.scarce: HL-native spot inventory as portfolio-margin collateral (PM cap 200 BTC a user; UBTC depth ~$2M within 25bp), or cheap capital on two venues

map.collector: HIP-3 shorts: market makers hedging at brokers in US hours
map.contestability: medium: needs a broker plus HL margin; books are thin outside the top names
map.method: HL venue OI x store funding (30/90d) plus Binance TradFi equity perps (realised 30d); clipped per market at the high end
map.motive: 24/7 leveraged US-equity exposure without a broker; off-hours price discovery
map.name: HIP-3 equity and index perps (+ Binance TradFi equity perps)
map.payer: leveraged longs in HIP-3 equity and index perps (trade.xyz and others)
map.repo: equity_offhours: thin go; tradfi_perps: Binance TradFi hedge no-go; book re-quoted $330k -> $54-73k/yr
map.scarce: a broker account (cash-equity hedge) and tolerance for off-hours gap risk

map.collector: the other side of the roll
map.method: excluded from rent: the oracle steps on the GSCI calendar and funding pays the step (roll_carry.py)
map.motive: none: the funding pays each roll step (0.89-0.97 of it), a calendar price
map.name: Energy perps (oil, gas): funding is the roll
map.payer: holders of energy perps (oil, gas) whose oracles roll on the GSCI schedule

map.collector: depositors in rewarded vaults and markets, pro-rata; curators route flows
map.contestability: high in capital, low in attention: a fixed budget dilutes as deposits arrive, but each campaign must be found and read
map.method: sum tvlUsd x apyReward over DefiLlama yield pools (outliers, >300% APR and pass-through vaults excluded); high end adds Merkl campaigns DefiLlama does not see and flagged pools under 50% APR
map.motive: marketing: growth of a stablecoin float or a market, paid from a fixed budget
map.name: Incentive budgets paid to depositors
map.payer: issuers and protocols buying deposits (Ethena loop programs, Sky, Spark, Usual, PayPal PYUSD, Ripple RLUSD, Robinhood USDG)
map.repo: stacyvault-reward-harvest retired; usdg-captive-flow-lp fork-proven ($150k); brainstorm 5.4 incentive-adjusted dollar yields is next (incentive_yields sibling)
map.scarce: attention (campaigns change weekly), eligibility (KYC: "Robinhood users only"; looping required), tolerance for the issuer's credit

map.collector: unknown: no basis desk is visible; Binance TradFi perps have no interest floor (46% of XAU settlements zero)
map.contestability: low-medium: the spot leg is on chain and liquid in size; the oracles follow spot (xyz GOLD/SILVER do not roll)
map.method: per-market OI x 30d (and 90d) funding on each venue, spot-following oracles; above fair against SSR
map.motive: 24/7 leveraged metal exposure from a crypto account (a broker barrier, like the equity carry)
map.name: Gold, silver and other metal perps (all four venues)
map.payer: leveraged longs in gold and silver perps (HL xyz, Binance, OKX, Bybit)
map.repo: tradfi_perps: perp-perp metals pair (HL vs Binance) gold +2.9%, never traded; no test of perp vs tokenized spot
map.scarce: a tokenized spot leg (PAXG/XAUT, 24/7, KYC to mint/redeem) and its depth; venue access (Binance TradFi perps non-US)

map.method: DefiLlama revenue of curator, aggregator and manager categories
map.name: Manager and curator fees (the take, not the yield passed through)
map.payer: passive depositors in curated vaults and yield aggregators

map.collector: PT holders (fixed-rate buyers, Morpho/Aave PT loopers) and Pendle LPs
map.contestability: medium: PT capacity is the market depth
map.method: YT totalSupply() on chain x accounting-asset price x (implied APY - trailing 30d underlying APY), 85 active markets
map.name: Points speculation: Pendle YT premium (implied - realised) on YT outstanding
map.payer: YT buyers on Pendle (points and airdrop speculation, rate bets)
map.repo: pendle_history: PT-over-floating switch go ($216k/yr); points markets median implied - trailing 4.3% vs 1.8%; Boros no-go
map.scarce: duration and patience to hold a PT to maturity

map.collector: DEX LPs, arbitrage bots, queue bidders
map.contestability: medium: few bidders, capital lock is the barrier
map.method: repo histories: sell volume x volume-weighted discount per pool (210-day and 743-day windows), above fair after the pool fee and the time value of the queue; low end the last 13 weeks; off-Ethereum LSTs from a 24h volume screen at 5-25bp
map.motive: impatience: immediate liquidity, mostly in stress weeks
map.name: Queue impatience: LST/LRT and BTC-wrapper discounts x sell volume
map.payer: holders of queued claims (stETH, weETH, rsETH, LBTC, tBTC) who will not wait days for a redemption
map.repo: dislocation_history + queue_bids_ext + queue_book: combined $15M book $409,889/yr out of sample; off-Ethereum screen (queue_bids_alt) running
map.scarce: capital that can sit locked in a queue for days to weeks
